note: Site BV003 on the Letterkenny Tract Access Road, 0.4 mile in from Mountain Road at Fort McCord: a gravel lot about 45 m long and 9 m wide in the woods that DCNR says holds two camper trailers or three vehicles with tents, booked as one site. Easy access but in view of the road; no fire ring or picnic table is listed in DCNR's map layer. A small stream runs about 100 ft away under the trees. State forest roads are not plowed in winter. --Claude
summary: Site page re-read: open year round, calendar offers nights (Nov 2026, May and Jul 2027), 60 ft, back-in gravel, slight, 20-ft clearance; no price block shown on this one page (fees from DCNR's price page). Imagery rendered (leaf-on): a gravel strip about 45 x 9 m exactly at the pin, a mown utility corridor 50 m SE; the stream is not visible under canopy. NHD: an unnamed intermittent flowline 37 m away and a perennial one 72 m away. 3DEP: the pad is 24 m above Mountain Road, 483 m away (5% mean). Pin matches ReserveAmerica and DCNR GIS.
flags: NO PRICE SHOWN: this site's ReserveAmerica page returned no price breakdown on dated queries although the calendar offers the nights (the same thing p3-358 saw on BV001). Fees written from DCNR's statewide price page and the $6.50 line on the other four Buchanan sites read today. Not labelled walk-up.

WATERFRONT LEAD (not written): booking page and brochure say 'Located 100 feet from stream' (about 30 m); NHD has an unnamed INTERMITTENT flowline 37 m from the pin and a perennial one at 72 m. Imagery is closed canopy and shows no water. A small intermittent stream out of sight would not normally earn an upgrade; reported only.

What it is: a gravel parking lot / former landing on the Letterkenny tract access road ('Gravel parking lot that can hold 2 camper trailers or 3 vehicles with tents. Easy access but visible from the roadway'). DCNR GIS: TrailerAccess 'Yes', FireRing 'No', PicnicTables 'No', NumberVehicles 3, '2 camper trailers of any size'. Not signed as a trailhead, ATV or snowmobile lot on any page read; the Buchanan ATV and snowmobile pages (p3-358's copies of the same day) do not name this road.
Equipment categories on the site page: 'RV Site, Tent Site, Trailer Site'.
Bear Valley brochure (July 2026): the one site marked 'CLOSED for Evaluation and Maintenance' is BV008 Clarks Knob (Broad Mountain Road at Clarks Knob Road), not this site.

Access: OSRM routes Edenville Road and Fort McCord Road to Mountain Road; the access road itself is not in OSRM's network (route ends on Mountain Road 483 m away). Surface of the access road, gates and any weight limit unread (Overpass did not answer).
Winter: the Buchanan camping page states no closure period; only the site page's 'not maintained in the winter' line.
Phone 717-485-3148 confirmed as the Buchanan district office (DCNR camping page and the Bear Valley brochure); apply.py does not write phone and no change is needed.
